title: Which skills own destination question card mechanics and the grilling-completion exit?
question: Which skills own destination question card mechanics and the grilling-completion exit?
answer:
GX-2: One focused DQC primitive owns shared card mechanics: find, create or group the right DQC, preserve locked-question lineage and corrections, link ADRs, Specs, Tasks and other artifacts, and record evidence-backed progress assessments. The existing workflow skills decide when to call it and what their own step proves, and are updated to compose it. No dedicated DQC review skill. Domain-modeling stays available but is not required in this flow.
GX-3: /to-dqc is the grilling-completion skill: it inspects every locked grilling answer and groups it into a suitable existing DQC, or creates a separate one when it evolves independently, preserving source question identity and corrections. /dqc is the reusable primitive for card operations and evidence-backed assessment, called by /to-dqc and by the mapping, planning, implementation, review and verification skills once those are updated.

confirmation.basis: Each source answer was owner-settled in its grilling session, per the grilling ledger at 56b459da: GX-2, GX-3 (locked). The card's grouping, title and synthesis are agent work (2026-09-26 draft grouping and the 2026-10-01 ledger backfill), not separately owner-confirmed.

expectedResult.change: GX-2 create workbench/skills (new DQC primitive; mapping, planning, implementation, review and verification skills): A reusable card primitive that the workflow skills compose. | GX-3 create workbench/skills/to-dqc/SKILL.md; workbench/skills/dqc/SKILL.md: The grilling-completion skill and the card primitive, by these names.
expectedResult.home: workbench/skills (new DQC primitive; mapping, planning, implementation, review and verification skills); workbench/skills/to-dqc/SKILL.md; workbench/skills/dqc/SKILL.md

uncertainty: GX-1..GX-3 (ledger note): the step meanings in these answers conflict with S-01T, LEXICON.md and workbench/tools/landmark-tracker.mjs, which say the steps describe documentation progress, never Task status or implementation effort; reconcile before Canon changes.
No Spec owns the /to-dqc or /dqc skills yet; naming one is a Director action (2026-10-01 backfill handoff).
